data.body_html:
Valentine's Day 2029 falls on a Wednesday, making it an ideal midweek escape to Marbella. A Marbella yacht charter for Valentine's Day 2029 proposal offers privacy, stunning sunset views, and a touch of luxury that a restaurant simply cannot match. Whether you are planning a surprise or a shared celebration, our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and includes everything you need – skipper, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Below is a practical guide to help you plan the perfect moment.

Read our main guide to boat rental in Marbella for general tips on chartering.

Why Choose a Yacht for a Valentine's Day Proposal?

A private yacht gives you complete control over the setting. You can anchor at a quiet cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, watch the sun set behind La Concha mountain, and pop the question with the Mediterranean as your backdrop. There are no crowds, no set menus, and no time limits (within your charter duration). The gentle motion of the boat and the sound of the waves add a natural romance that is hard to replicate on land.

Best Boats for an Intimate Proposal

For a romantic proposal, we recommend our Tier A boats – the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both are priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours (skipper, drinks, and VAT included). These boats are spacious enough for a couple plus a few close friends, but small enough to feel intimate. If you want more space, consider the Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) or the Pershing 46 (10 pax) – pricing on request.

Sunset Timing and Route Ideas

In mid-February, sunset in Marbella is around 18:45. We suggest a 2-hour charter departing at 16:45 to catch the golden hour. A popular route is: Puerto Banús → Cala del Faro (anchor for photos) → return via the coast. For a longer sunset experience, book a 3-hour slot (16:00-19:00) and include a stop at Cala Cortés. The average sea temperature in February is 15°C, so bring a light jacket for the deck.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For a proposal, you can upgrade to Champagne (€60-90 per bottle) or request decorations like rose petals and balloons (free, with 48-hour notice). Our skippers are discreet and happy to help with the ring or a photographer.

How to Book and Plan Ahead

February is low season, so availability is good – but we recommend booking 2-4 weeks in advance to secure your preferred boat and time. To book, contact us via WhatsApp (pricing on request for non-Tier A boats). We will confirm the details, including any special requests. On the day, arrive at Puerto Banús 15 minutes early. The skipper will greet you, and you can set off for your private cruise.

For more ideas, check our Valentine's Day proposal guide for inspiration.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best time for a Valentine's Day proposal cruise in Marbella?

We recommend a 2-hour sunset cruise departing around 16:45 in mid-February. Sunset is at approximately 18:45, giving you golden light for photos and a romantic backdrop. A 3-hour option lets you enjoy the stars after.

Which boat is best for a proposal on Valentine's Day 2029?

The Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (both Tier A at €749/2h) are ideal for an intimate proposal. They accommodate 9-11 guests, so you can invite a few close friends or keep it private. Both depart from Puerto Banús.

Can I decorate the yacht for the proposal?

Yes, we can arrange decorations like rose petals, balloons, or a banner upon request. Let us know at least 48 hours in advance. There is no extra charge, but we appreciate a small contribution for materials.

Is champagne included in the Valentine's Day charter?

Our standard inclusions cover cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. For a proposal, you can upgrade to a bottle of Champagne (e.g., Moët or Veuve Clicquot) for an additional €60-90. Just ask when booking.

What happens if the weather is bad on Valentine's Day?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we offer a full refund or reschedule to the next available day. February can be windy, but Marbella usually enjoys mild, stable weather.

Can I propose at a specific location like Cala del Faro?

Absolutely. Our skippers know the best spots. For a proposal, we can anchor at Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or along the Golden Mile. The route is flexible – just tell us your preference.

How far in advance should I book for Valentine's Day 2029?

February is low season, so availability is good. We recommend booking 2-4 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Last-minute bookings are possible but may have limited options.

Can I bring my own ring or photographer?

Yes, you are welcome to bring the ring. For a photographer, we can arrange one on board at an additional cost of €150 for 1 hour. Or you can ask a friend to capture the moment – our skipper is happy to help too.
